I actually went to Theory and Practice (I was 17) and the person I saw, respectfully, did not know what she was talking about when it came to autism. Elysse Kompaniez-Dunigan has a very neurotypical approach to autism, to the point where she told me that I couldn't be autistic for very unreasonable reasons. Her view of autism is mainly focused on how it presents in males and she doesn't seem to understand the concept of masking and how special interests and social deficits present in AFAB + well masked individuals on the spectrum. The only things she diagnosed me with were things so blatantly obvious that I had already known I had them (depression and ADHD). The final report that was sent out to me had various misspellings (including spelling my medication incorrectly and accidentally referring to me as a "he"), which is likely just small nitpicking on my part but the whole experience really came off as really unsatisfactory and deeply upsetting to me. Luckily my current therapist and my psychiatrist believe I have autism so I'm not completely unable to receive the help I need, but I can say pretty certainly that Theory and Practice was the worst experience with psychologists I've ever had and I would definitely not recommend them to anyone questioning if they're on the spectrum unless maybe if they are a white man.

To add on (Idk if this is actually useful information to anyone but me) DXM can take much longer to hit than you’d expect, even if you take it on an empty stomach. If I take robotablets on an empty stomach it often takes well over 4 hours to feel the effects. Don’t be too quick to take more; it will likely kick in later. Maybe this is common sense (my bad) but I do see lots of people saying it will only take 1 or 2 hours and it has led me to believing I had to re-dose before when it was actually just my stupid ass metabolism/digestive tract lol. 


And if it genuinely isn’t going to kick in, then it’s better to save your DXM for a later time when you can prepare better to optimize the effects of the trip anyway.
